item.title: Ukrainian Drones Plant Mines on Main Road to Energodar Every Night – Rosatom CEO
item.summary: MOSCOW (Sputnik) - The delivery of new personnel to the Zaporozhye Nuclear Power Plant (ZNPP) has become a deadly task because of the mining of roads in Energodar by the Ukrainian Armed Forces, Russian state nuclear corporation Rosatom CEO Alexey Likhachev said on Wednesday.
